cards.name: Camp Lakey Gap
cards.description: Residential camp for autistic campers with visually structured activities and individualized staff support. Activities include arts and crafts, hiking, creek games, swimming, music, and canoeing.

season.text: Weeks of June 14, 21, and 28 - Camp Lakey Gap for participants with autism

financial_aid.text: Scholarships are available on a limited basis and are need-based.

special_needs.text: We provide 1:1 or 1:2 support for all campers to help make the transition to camp easier and to meet each camper where they are.
